I am a postdoctoral researcher at CIDE-CSIC-UV, working on severe convection
and its links to climate change — supercells, hail, and convectively-driven
extreme wind gusts in the Mediterranean and beyond.

I am also a co-founder of the Spanish Supercell and Hail citizen science
project ([@Supercelulas](https://twitter.com/Supercelulas)), recovering
historical and current supercell and hail reports across Spain.
